# Feature menu

<!-- Generated by tools/export/build.mjs from export.manifest.json. Edit the manifest, not this file. -->

Every item you can adopt from this kit, by module, with two flags:

- **Importance:** `core` means the rest of the adoption depends on it; `recommended` fixes a problem most people have; `optional` fixes a problem only some have. The Why column says which problem.
- **Context cost:** `none` runs outside Claude, like a git hook; `on demand` loads only when it is used, like a skill's body; `every session` loads before your first message, like an instruction file or a skill's description. Token counts are estimates (the size in bytes divided by 4), and an item at 1,000 tokens or more every session is marked heavy.

Tick whole modules, or pick single items from any module. `drill-to-adopt` asks you and writes your answers to `adoption/features.md` in your setup. Each item has an adoption card, `cards/<item>.md`: how it is detected, what you are asked, what it needs, the steps, the check, the undo and what to watch out for.

The kit's own skills, `drill-to-adopt`, `vet-and-adopt` and `setup-workspace`, are not on this menu: they run from the kit folder during the adoption and are never installed into your setup.

## Domains

A domain is a set of skills for one kind of job, installed together as a pack. Each costs one short description every session (the entry); its index and the skills inside load only when a task reaches them. `drill-to-adopt` offers the domains that fit your work, and "none of these" is a valid answer. Each domain has an adoption card, `cards/pack-<domain>.md`, and also comes as a zip for claude.ai (see [START-HERE](../START-HERE.md)).

## Not in this version

- **The knowledge wiki graph** (heavy): A generator, a graph tool and upkeep after every session; worth it only once memory and handoff are a habit.
- **The session archive** (heavy): Keeps every transcript, so it needs its own privacy rules first.

The catalog-only skills, grouped by domain, are listed in [catalog/INDEX.md](INDEX.md); they are not on this menu.
